dominant_strengths: Faithful Linear-native dark palette and restrained type system create a credible, on-brand changelog feel with strong visual hygiene
Inline product mock with colored team icons gives a crisp, demonstrative artifact that communicates the feature instantly
Tab-style filter row (All, Changelog, Community...) is well-weighted, with active state subtly distinguished without ornament
dominant_weaknesses: Massive empty left column under the date wastes vertical real estate and makes the entry feel orphaned in a wide canvas
Hero 'Now' header sits disconnected from filters and entry, lacking a tightening rule, eyebrow, or hierarchy bridge
Zero distinctive moves beyond Linear's existing aesthetic—no temporal scaffolding, version tagging, or motion cue that elevates it past template
fix_priorities: Introduce a sticky date/version rail or constrain the content column to reduce left-side void and improve scan rhythm
Strengthen header-to-content transition with a divider, eyebrow label, or category chip near the title
Add a signature craft detail (animated diff, subtle entry transition, or version badge) to differentiate from a stock changelog
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral polish carries it, but behavioral wayfinding is thin and reflective payoff is muted by lack of distinctive identity.
rationale.intent_fit: Yes—it reads convincingly as a Linear changelog page, though it mostly mirrors the reference rather than extending it.
